description: Synthetic stress-test document with deliberately injected conflicts. Two tables report the same entity/metric/period with a >10% discrepancy. Ground truth: the system MUST detect and flag these as conflicts. This document does NOT represent real CMPDI data.
synthetic_document_content_description: Two tables: Table A reports BCCL coal_production 2022-23 = 24.5 MT; Table B reports BCCL coal_production 2022-23 = 27.1 MT (discrepancy ~10.6%). Both appear in the same synthetic PDF.

labels.note: System must detect this as an open conflict. If conflict not flagged, this is a FN (false negative).
Entity should still resolve correctly even in conflicted document
At least one fact must be normalized to MT regardless of the conflict
